notes.title: v[0.07] Color Customization: Checkouts
notes.content: [h1]Color Customization: Cash Registers and Self-Checkout Machines[/h1][p]Now it's possible to change the color of your cash registers and self-checkout machines.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/404edf3a0d3a922198e99f0957c294cc53eb5d8a.jpg"][/img]You can customize the cash register and self-checkout machine colors by pressing the [i]B-key (by default)[/i] when you hover over them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/34ca9752c14b778655b5373b1a4dd8008d818324.jpg"][/img][b]It's B-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.[/b][/p][p][b]Keybinding: Options -> Controls -> Customize Color[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/1688ba3056774bb554d35b16dc74788ff35a2153.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v[0.06] New Racks
notes.content: [p][/p][h1][b]New Racks[/b][/h1][p][i]Two new racks have been added to the Market-Equipment section.[/i] [/p][list][*][p][b]Two-Tier Rack[/b][/p][p](Capacity: 18)[/p][p][i](for normal size products)[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Small Wall Rack[/b][/p][p](Capacity: 24)[/p][p][i](for normal size products)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/7cf22fe266082fce7949b064fde4b841cb5109bb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/7866344d9963808fa57e183adde947379954d66c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]You can find these new racks in the Market-Equipment section.[/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/e2cf26f72f7ad02d675c4a6babd7eae894bef472.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/9fdcd16162c7f0ab4bc55ececba171b503437bef.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/da008a96d78fc8ad70a1aacb236cd3eaaf780653.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v[0.05] Color Customization: Store Racks
notes.content: [h1]Color Customization: Store Racks[/h1][p]Now it's possible to change the color of your store racks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/288d17057a273f22290d680b4ee4e3cdf9c3504b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can customize the store rack colors by pressing the [i]B-key (by default)[/i] when you hover over a store rack.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/87549ef55eb8c8cda372cae16a77bc8b05d4abdf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]It's B-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.[/b][/p][p][b]Keybinding: Options -> Controls -> Customize Color[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/1688ba3056774bb554d35b16dc74788ff35a2153.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Please select "Apply to the same type" if you want all the same type of store racks in the same color.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/62320eba2bc275789a9e94ad19283c722f948cdb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Please select "Apply to all" if you want all the store racks in the same color.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/ffb3f9ae7b8fa8c43dabc950f83885dc8c7d1c19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
